scope: Coherent per-family multi-head inference and complete runner-advisory artifact approval; read-only historical extreme-runner evidence assessment and bounded Windows Parquet writer contention handling.
findings: Per-target lazy path pinning did not bind previously unread targets to the same selector; standalone queue ranking had no inference scope.
A manifest approved model bytes but did not bind original validation metadata, including rank references and cohort evidence.
Multi-head wrappers could read changing family artifacts outside a supervised entry.
A malformed numeric receipt column could be proposed as a diagnostic primary predictor before the financial feature allowlist.

The eligible historical population contains scarce extreme shadow peaks and no current checked estimated-net or original auxiliary-v3 receipt population; it cannot establish current profitable opportunity capture.

A final concurrent writer test raised Windows EACCES at exclusive lock-file creation. Windows delete-pending semantics are a consistent possible explanation, not a verified OS trace; the original code handled only FileExistsError.

implementation.family_selection: Pin the whole selector, including absence or invalidity, once per decision. Capture all selected checked model objects and detached metadata before the first prediction. Require the file collection to remain stable while capturing; changes return unknown, never a mixed selection.
implementation.legacy_flat: Preserve compatible individually checked flat-family artifacts with a stable collection snapshot, without claiming a common training cohort or a published approval generation.
implementation.versioned_approval: Require selected model and metadata SHA-256 plus family, target, version and ranking-only role before deserialization. Bind the exact common manifest identity into detached nonpredictor queue-priority provenance. Independently retained heads from different accepted cohorts remain explicitly distinct.
implementation.runner_lifecycle: Pipeline version 6 makes the stronger approval part of the learning generation. New selected references include the final original metadata hash. Preserve old model-only references and bytes, leave them unknown and permit only an independently validated successor; do not rehash old metadata to manufacture approval. Actual checksum corruption preserves the incumbent and fails the cycle. Rollback rejects missing or changed approval metadata, identities and unsupported encodings.
implementation.scope_ownership: Standalone queue and runner/risk/continuation/EV multi-head wrappers own a short scope; children of an existing entry reuse its scope without closing or replacing the parent. Scope exit drains pinned metadata and prediction cache ownership.
implementation.unchanged_behavior: No new buy veto, safety bypass, take-profit ceiling, order-size change or active policy/model activation. Unknown ranks remain neutral; learned bonus stays bounded at 20. Exact 0.1 SOL paper sizing and uncapped proportional runner exits remain in force.
implementation.nonpredictor_guard: Exclude the physical auxiliary receipt column explicitly from the generic primary feature selector even if a malformed file gives it a numeric dtype.
implementation.read_only_population_audit: Reusable profiling counts eligible settled row/token grain, duplicates, causal join coverage, nested thresholds, day-level observations, checked net provenance and current auxiliary generation without training, providers or runtime writes. Companion notebook is task-local and is not published with personal runtime data.
implementation.windows_parquet_lock: Retry known Windows access/sharing/lock errors only within the original acquisition deadline and require a successful O_CREAT|O_EXCL before any read-modify-write. Persistent access denial still prevents writing and preserves another owner's lock and the original Parquet. Unknown permission failures propagate immediately. Owner-record write failure now closes the acquired descriptor and removes only its own lock before propagating; atomic publication and existing stale-lock policy are unchanged.

historical_population.qualification: These are eligible observed historical shadow peaks, not live or paper orders or executable/costed profits. Thresholds overlap; interval endpoints are partial; repeated tokens are not independent evidence. No conclusion about universe-wide current coverage is supported.
